content: Chrome installability (official blog update-install-criteria 2023-12, still current): menu-install no longer requires a service worker fetch handler (mobile 108+, desktop 112+), but the automatic install PROMPT algorithm still requires a fetch handler; Chrome 112 ignores empty/no-op service workers, so any SW must be non-trivial. HTTPS required. MDN (Sep 2026) lists required manifest members: name or short_name, icons incl 192px and 512px, start_url, display, prefer_related_applications false.
